messages:
release-bot: Initiating canary rollout release/2026-03-21 v3.0 -> canary 1/4 (api-gateway -> embeddings route)
sam.t: heads-up: v3.0 includes model quantization changes and a new batching path. i'll watch latency SLOs and error rates closely.
tara: p95 on embeddings upstream jumped from 110ms -> 155ms in us-east at 16:02 UTC. p50 stable. 5xx rose from 0.02% -> 0.07% but still low. dashboard: https://internal.redwood/d/embeds/slo?panelId=5
liam: traces point to CPU spikes on canary hosts, a lot of kernel scheduling during batch assembly. suspect quantized path is introducing CPU hotspots at certain sequence lengths. trace ids: trace-a12 trace-a13
devops-bot: Noted: canary instance embed-canary-2 restarted at 16:03:21 UTC (killed by OOMKiller)
sre-oncall: OOM kill is concerning. recommend immediate reduce traffic to 15% and capture heap/profile. if we see >0.2% 5xx in next 3m, prepare to pin to v2.16 or rollback. also open a perf-gather ticket.
sam.t: reducing shift to 15% now. grabbing perf profiles on canaries.
ops-bot: perf-snapshot created: ps-5443222222. Links: https://internal.redwood/prof/ps-5443222222
tara: quick repro from us-east that mimics the tail:
```bash
python load_test.py --route /embeds --batch_size 8 --seq_len 512 --qps 10
# results: median=0.112s p95=0.153s p99=0.29s
```
liam: sequence-length dependence is real. shorter sequences look fine. i'll attempt a canary config tweak to limit max_batch_size for v3.0 path to avoid queuing pressure.
sre-oncall: also verify KV cache residency; eviction on low-memory hosts could amplify latency.
sam.t: applied soft config: max_batch_size=6 for canary pods at 16:09. monitoring...
release-bot: Canary traffic adjusted: 15% -> canary config updated
devops-bot: Autoscaler disabled for embed-canary pool (temporary) at 16:09:45 UTC to keep instances stable during profiling
tara: after config change p95 dropped to ~118ms at 16:12. heap profiles show higher malloc churn on quantized path.
liam: plan: keep canary at 15% for 10m, collect allocation profiles, and attempt to build a reduced-quantization patch if churn persists. if stable for 10m, continue ramp.
sre-oncall: agreed. if we see another OOM or >0.25% 5xx, execute rollback pin: `/deploy pin --service api-gateway --route /embeds --version v2.16 --reason "quantization OOM/latency regression"`
sam.t: adding a line in release notes: "v3.0 initial canary observed higher tail latency on long sequences — mitigated by temporary batch-size cap; further perf patch in progress."
release-bot: Canary snapshot taken (id: cs-5443222222). Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy-observability
ops-bot: reminder: change window ends at 18:00 UTC; if we need extended mitigation/rollback, notify PM and schedule follow-up outside window.
tara: confirming p95 stable ~115-120ms for the last 3m, no new OOMs. ready to slowly ramp to 40% if everyone agrees.
sre-oncall: +1 to ramp to 40% but keep autoscaler disabled and monitor for 15m. keep pin/rollback command at the ready.
sam.t: ramping to 40% now, will update release notes and create a ticket for quantization memory optimization. thanks folks :thumbsup:
